wk.beta.text: There is no price yet, because there is nothing to buy yet. If you want in now, create an account and access is unlocked by hand.
wk.bild: A slope with a slalom line
wk.fuer.text: The same group works as a squad, a club, a gym or a family. What changes are the words: where the squad has a head coach and athletes, the gym has a manager and members, and the training camp becomes a workshop. The structure stays the same.
wk.hero.text: Plans, dates, video analysis and race results — instead of four group chats, two spreadsheets and a folder full of PDFs.
wk.k1.text: One programme for the whole group, or one for a single athlete. Several coaches work side by side without overwriting each other.
wk.k2.text: Training sessions, camps and races. The announcement hangs on the event as a PDF and can be replaced later. If something is off, it is cancelled and not deleted — otherwise someone is standing at the lift on Saturday.
wk.k3.text: A skeleton over the run, joint angles, turn transitions. The analysis runs in the browser — the video is not sent to any server for it.
wk.k4.text: Race times in the athlete profile, and from them the standing by the FIS formula. Without a penalty nothing is guessed — nothing is shown.
wk.nichts.text: Athletes need no setup. They get a code, join and see their plan. No subscription, no account with the provider, no app from a store.
